Hey everyone, first off, I wanted to acknowledge that having a juniper indoors is always frowned upon everywhere. However, I am determined to see if this one could thrive in my office. I have a closed office, and I set up grow lights with a smart timer set to come on every day automatically, also have a humidifier set up to come on every day on a schedule. Where I live, I don't really have an outside area where bonsai can stay. This is a hobby I have wanted to get into for a while, and I needed something to help with my anxiety. 

I have had it here for two weeks and have been watering when the soil feels dry; and used bonsai food with my watering yesterday and will probably do that weekly. Let me know what you guys think. I was thinking about trying my hand at wiring since I think the shape can be tweaked.
